# twinweb-creator

> An ecommerce storefront with a built-in blog, product catalog, and admin tools. Browse electronics and tech products, read articles, and manage orders through the admin panel.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured products, promotions, and latest blog posts.
- [Products](/products): Browse the full product catalog.
- [Product Detail](/products/:id): Individual product pages with details and add-to-cart.
- [New Products](/new-products): Recently added products.
- [Offers](/offers): Current deals and promotions.
- [About](/about): Information about the store and team.
- [Contact](/contact): Contact form and support details.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles, news, and buying guides.
- [Blog Post](/blog/:slug): Individual blog articles.
- [Support](/support): Help center and customer support information.
- [Shipping](/shipping): Shipping policies and delivery information.
- [Returns](/returns): Return and refund policies.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
